ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the factor's goods
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: A factor asks the colony to keep crates of goods for a season. What the colony does with them decides how the factor's people deal with it afterwards.

outcomes.li: [keep,outcome:kept] all the crates kept, sealed and dry
[keep,outcome:lost] some crates lost, opened, sold or spoiled
[rival,outcome:told] the offer refused, and word sent to {GIVER}
[rival,outcome:declined] the colony did not meet the trader
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:rival] {GIVER}'s crates are in the colony's stores until {GIVER} comes for them.
[next:makegood] {GIVER} will send word about the lost crates.
[next:debt] {GIVER} has heard about the sale of the crates.
[end:guards] {GIVER} has not been paid for the crates.
[end:unpaid] {GIVER}'s people are coming for the crates that are left.
[end:madegood] {GIVER}'s people are coming for the crates that are left.
[end:faded] {GIVER}'s people are coming for the crates.

summaries.li: {GIVER} of {FACTION} asked the colony to keep some crates of goods, and the colony said no.

texts.li: [!missing,!told] {GIVER} of {FACTION} came to the gate with porters and took back the crates. {GIVER} paid {SILVER} silver for the season's keeping.\n\nFor the next year, {GIVER} will come by once a season with a share of the trade for the colony.

[!missing,told] {GIVER} of {FACTION} came to the gate with porters and took back the crates. {GIVER} paid {SILVER} silver for the season's keeping, and thanked the colony for sending word about the trader who wanted to buy them.\n\nFor the next year, {GIVER} will come by once a season with a share of the trade for the colony.

[missing] {GIVER} of {FACTION} came to the gate with porters for the crates. Some went missing or were spoiled after the clerk's count, so {GIVER} paid only {SILVER} silver for the keeping.\n\nFor the next year, {GIVER} will still come by once a season with a share of the trade for the colony.

summaries.li: [!told] the colony kept {GIVER}'s crates for a season, and {GIVER} brings it a share of the trade for a year.
[told] the colony kept {GIVER}'s crates for a season and refused to sell them behind {GIVER}'s back, and {GIVER} brings it a share of the trade for a year.

texts.li: {GIVER} of {FACTION} came for the crates and found them gone. The colony sold them to {RIVAL}, but {GIVER} does not know that and believes they were stolen.\n\n{GIVER} left without paying for the keeping, and {FACTION} trust the colony a little less.

summaries.li: the colony sold {GIVER}'s crates to {RIVAL}, and {GIVER} believes they were stolen.
the colony sold {GIVER}'s crates, {GIVER} found out, and the colony paid what they were worth.

texts.li: The colony did not pay {GIVER} for the crates it sold. Guards of {FACTION} have come to the gate to say that {FACTION} will not trade with the colony for a year.\n\n{FACTION} think much less of the colony now, and none of their traders will come until the year is out.

summaries.li: the colony sold {GIVER}'s crates and never paid for them, so {FACTION} stopped trading with it for a year.
some of {GIVER}'s crates were lost in the colony's care, and the colony paid what they were worth.

texts.li: The colony did not pay {GIVER} for the crates that were lost. {GIVER}'s people have come for the crates that are left.\n\n{FACTION} will send no traders to the colony for a year.

summaries.li: some of {GIVER}'s crates were lost and the colony did not pay for them, so {FACTION} sent no traders for a year.

titles.li: Nobody will come for the crates

texts.li: [war,opened] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, so nobody will come for {GIVER}'s crates. The colony opened them and kept what was inside.
[destroyed,opened] {FACTION} are gone, so nobody will come for {GIVER}'s crates. The colony opened them and kept what was inside.
[war,!opened] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and {GIVER}'s business with the colony is over.
[destroyed,!opened] {FACTION} are gone, and {GIVER}'s business with the colony is over.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony, and {GIVER}'s business with it ended.
[destroyed] {FACTION} are gone, and {GIVER}'s business with the colony ended.
nothing more came of {GIVER}'s business with the colony.

ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the beast coming down the valley
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: Hunters warn the colony that a great beast is coming its way. The colony gets ready, finds its tracks, and faces it.

outcomes.li: [ready,outcome:ready] traps or walls built and the animals kept in
[signs,outcome:found] the kill and the tracks seen
[beast,outcome:declined] the colony stayed in, and the hunters turned {NAME} away
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:beast,!back] {NAME} is close to the colony's land.
[next:beast,back] {FACTION}'s hunters think {NAME} will come back next season.

summaries.li: {FACTION} warned the colony that {NAME}, a great {KIND}, was coming. The colony did not get ready, and their hunters turned it away.
[!tamed] the colony killed {NAME}, the great {KIND} that came down the valley, and {FACTION} honoured it for that.
[tamed] the colony tamed {NAME}, the great {KIND} that came down the valley, and {FACTION} honoured it for that.

texts.li: [beast:declined] The colony stayed in, and {FACTION}'s hunters turned {NAME} away from the valley. It will not come near the colony now.
[!beast:declined] {NAME} has not come back. {FACTION}'s hunters say it has moved on to another part of the region.

summaries.li: [beast:declined] the colony left {NAME}, the great {KIND}, to {FACTION}'s hunters, and they turned it away.
[!beast:declined] {NAME}, the great {KIND}, was driven off and did not come back.

texts.li: [war] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, and their hunters no longer tell the colony anything about {NAME}.
[destroyed] {FACTION} are gone, and nobody is watching {NAME} for the colony any more.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony while {NAME} was still about.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone before {NAME} was dealt with.
{NAME}, the great {KIND}, never came to the colony's land.

ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.label: the children from the burned village
ColonyCouncil.StorylineDef.description: Children whose village burned down come to the colony for shelter. The colony decides what becomes of them, and seasons later one of them comes back.

outcomes.li: [shelter,outcome:place] a home found for them with {OTHERPEOPLE}
[shelter,outcome:harmed] some of them died in the colony's care
[back,outcome:notjoined] {NAME} asked to join, and the colony said no
[outcome:gone] ended when {FACTION} turned against the colony

coming.li: [next:back,place] The children from the burned village have a new home with {OTHERPEOPLE}.
[next:back,sendon] The children from the burned village have gone on.

summaries.li: children whose village burned asked the colony for shelter, and the colony said no.
the colony took in {COUNT} children whose village burned, and they are colonists now.
children whose village burned came to the colony for shelter, and some of them died there.
{NAME}, one of the children from the burned village, came back grown and joined the colony.
[back:visited] {NAME}, one of the children from the burned village, came back grown to visit the colony.
[back:traded] {NAME}, one of the children from the burned village, came back grown and traded at the gate.
[back:notjoined] {NAME}, one of the children from the burned village, came back grown and asked to join, and the colony said no.
{NAME}, one of the children from the burned village, did not come by after all.

texts.li: [war] {FACTION} are at war with the colony now, so the children from the burned village will not stay with the colony.
[destroyed] {FACTION} are gone, and the children from the burned village will not stay with the colony.

summaries.li: [war] {FACTION} turned against the colony, and the children from the burned village went on.
[destroyed] {FACTION} were gone, and the children from the burned village went on.
nothing more was heard of {NAME} from the burned village.
